Name: Map Studio
Author: xzqute
Description:
[size=5][b]Map Studio 1.0.1 Playtest[/b][/size]
[size=4]
I put this build on Nexus so people could try the mod and tell me what they think. I've kept the page short for the playtest.

Stardew Map Studio lets you make maps right inside Stardew Valley. Start with a blank map or open one from the game. I tried to make the tools easy to find, and the first time you open the editor, there's a short tutorial that shows you the basics.

Click Test to walk around your map and see how it feels in-game. You can save it as a Studio project to keep working on it later, or export it as a TMX file or a Content Patcher pack.[/size]

[size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*][size=4]You'll need Stardew Valley 1.6.15 and SMAPI 4.5.x.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Download the ZIP and extract it into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Start the game through SMAPI and click Map Studio on the title screen. If you've already loaded a save, press F9 while you're in the game.[/size][/*]
[/list][size=4]The editor is for single-player with a mouse and keyboard. To use an exported Content Patcher pack in the game, you'll need Content Patcher 2.9 or later.[/size]

[size=5][b]Feedback[/b][/size]
[size=4]
If you give it a go, I'd love to hear how it went. If you got stuck or couldn't find a tool, leave a comment with what you were trying to do. For a crash or a SMAPI error, please include your SMAPI log and what you did just before it happened.[/size]

Downloads.Description: Playtest new maps faster or start a test from a single-player save. Added Japanese, Chinese, and Korean text support, live layer previews in Save object, grid controls, and wallpaper and flooring previews. Event Studio can't open while editing.
